title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 5,351–5,400 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

words.definition: 精密細木工藝；木作藝術

examples.en: Traditional Japanese and Taiwanese woodworking crafts create strong furniture without using a single metal nail.
examples.zh: 傳統台日細木工藝追求無釘無膠的極致結構，打造能使用百年的實木家具。

examples.en: He transformed his garage into a cozy woodworking studio equipped with saws, drills, and chisels.
examples.zh: 他把自己的車庫改造成一間溫馨的木工工作室，配備齊全的手鋸、電鑽與鑿刀。

examples.en: Taking an evening woodworking class taught her how to measure, cut, and assemble solid wood cabinets.
examples.zh: 參加夜間木工研習課程，教會了她如何精準度量、裁切並組裝全實木櫥櫃。

words.definition: 榫卯木工接合結構工藝

examples.en: Master carpenters master complex interlocking wood joinery that tightens securely when humidity changes.
examples.zh: 傳統木作大木作師傅精通複雜的互鎖榫卯結構，隨四季濕度膨脹收縮依然緊密穩固。

examples.en: The antique dining table was constructed using traditional Japanese joinery without screws or brackets.
examples.zh: 這張古董餐桌採用傳統日式木作接合工藝打造，完全不需要螺絲釘或金屬角鐵加固。

examples.en: Precise timber joinery requires meticulous measuring and exceptional hand-tool control.
examples.zh: 製作精密的木材接合結構，需要一絲不苟的細心測量與卓越精湛的手工具控制技巧。

words.definition: 凹狀榫眼榫孔；鑿榫眼

examples.en: The craftsman carefully hollowed out a rectangular mortise in the oak leg using a razor-sharp chisel.
examples.zh: 木工師傅手持鋒利無比的鑿刀，在橡木桌腳上細心鑿出方正對稱的凹槽榫孔。

examples.en: He cleaned the freshly cut mortise to remove lingering sawdust before inserting the crossbeam.
examples.zh: 在將橫樑推入之前，他細心清理剛鑿好的榫孔內部，徹底清除殘留的微小木屑。

examples.en: The lock assembly fits snugly into the mortise carved into the edge of the heavy wooden door.
examples.zh: 門鎖機械結構嚴絲合縫地嵌入預先在厚重實木大門邊緣鑿出的鎖匣榫孔中。

words.definition: 凸狀榫頭；榫舌

examples.en: The carved wooden tenon slides smoothly into the corresponding mortise with a satisfying, snug click.
examples.zh: 精心手工雕鑿的凸起榫頭，在推入對應榫眼時發出清脆卡入聲，嚴絲合縫分毫不差。

examples.en: If the tenon is too loose, the carpenter applies a thin wooden shim to ensure a solid bond.
examples.zh: 如果榫頭試組時略顯鬆動，木工師傅會塞入一片極薄的木墊片以確保接合結構堅固。

examples.en: Skilled furniture makers ensure each tenon is cut perfectly square with grain running lengthwise.
examples.zh: 技術高超的家具匠人確保每個榫頭都切割得方方正正，且木紋順向延伸以提供最大承載力。

words.definition: 梯形燕尾榫接合；緊密吻合

examples.en: Hand-cut dovetail joints on solid pine drawer corners resist pulling forces effortlessly for decades.
examples.zh: 實木松木抽屜轉角處的手工燕尾榫，能輕鬆承受數十年的拉扯拉力而不鬆動脫落。

examples.en: The company's corporate expansion plans dovetail nicely with the government's green energy initiatives.
examples.zh: 這家企業未來的海外擴張營運藍圖，恰好與政府大力推動的綠色永續能源政策緊密契合。

examples.en: Seeing hand-cut dovetail corners is an immediate indicator of superior woodworking quality.
examples.zh: 看到抽屜轉角處手工雕鑿的梯形燕尾榫，是行家一眼辨識頂級家具工藝水準的標誌。

words.definition: 四十五度斜角對接接合；斜接

examples.en: The picture framer cut precise 45-degree miter joints to form a seamless, square wooden frame.
examples.zh: 畫框裝裱師傅裁切出精準的四十五度斜角接合，拼合成天衣無縫的方正原木畫框。

examples.en: He used an electric miter saw to trim baseboards quickly and cleanly during the room renovation.
examples.zh: 在房間裝修翻新期間，他使用電動斜切鋸快速且整齊俐落地裁切踢腳板。

examples.en: Corner clamps held the four glued miter joints firmly together until the adhesive dried.
examples.zh: 直角木工固定夾將四處塗膠的斜角對接處緊密固定在一起，直到木工膠完全乾燥。

words.definition: FSC 認證永續林業優質原木木材

examples.en: Furniture designers select certified sustainable timber harvested from responsibly managed plantations.
examples.zh: 高級原木家具設計師嚴選獲得國際 FSC 永續認證、來自合法經營造林農場的優質原木木料。

examples.en: High winds during the mountain storm caused several towering timber trees to snap and fall across trails.
examples.zh: 高山暴風雨中的強陣風導致數棵高聳的大型木材林木折斷，橫倒在登山步道上。

examples.en: Canada and Sweden are major global exporters of structural softwoods and construction timber.
examples.zh: 加拿大與瑞典是全球重要的建築用軟木結構材與高品質工程原木出口大國。

words.definition: 原木天然年輪木紋；紋理

examples.en: Applying transparent oil brings out the swirling golden grain and natural character of solid walnut.
examples.zh: 塗刷上一層清澈護木油，能將胡桃木天然交織的如流水般優美年輪木紋完美顯透。

examples.en: Always sand parallel to the wood grain to avoid leaving visible cross-scratches on the surface.
examples.zh: 進行砂磨作業時務必順著木材紋理平行打磨，以避免在木頭表面留下難以消除的橫向刮痕。

examples.en: Whole wheat bread contains all parts of the natural grain, providing abundant dietary fiber and nutrients.
examples.zh: 全麥麵包保留了天然穀物顆粒的所有部分，能為人體提供豐富的膳食纖維與微量營養。

words.definition: 台灣特有種珍貴紅檜與扁柏 (檜木)

examples.en: Ancient Taiwan Hinoki cypress timber is prized worldwide for its rot-resistant durability and heavenly aroma.
examples.zh: 台灣特有珍貴國寶級台灣檜木，以其防蟲耐腐、經久不壞與清甜持久的芳香享譽全球。

examples.en: Tall Mediterranean cypress trees flanked the winding gravel driveway leading up to the Tuscan villa.
examples.zh: 高聳挺拔的地中海絲柏柏樹整齊列隊在蜿蜒的碎石車道兩旁，一路引向托斯卡尼別墅。

examples.en: Traditional Japanese bath tubs crafted from fragrant cypress offer deeply relaxing therapeutic soaks.
examples.zh: 採用芳香檜木精製的傳統日式泡湯浴桶，能為沐浴者帶來極致療癒身心的溫暖享受。

words.definition: 散發天然森林芬多精清香的

examples.en: Handcrafted cedar bathtub trays release sweet aromatic oils when exposed to warm bath steam.
examples.zh: 純手工打造的雪松原木泡澡置物架，在熱氣蒸騰中源源不絕釋放出療癒放鬆的天然芬多精芳香。

examples.en: Freshly ground cinnamon and cloves created an aromatic fragrance that filled the bakery kitchen.
examples.zh: 現磨的肉桂粉與丁香顆粒散發出濃郁芳香的撲鼻香氣，瀰漫在整個烘焙坊廚房中。

examples.en: Herbal teas made with dried chamomile flowers and lemongrass offer wonderful aromatic soothing benefits.
examples.zh: 由乾燥洋甘菊與新鮮檸檬草沖泡而成的花草茶，散發著令人心曠神怡的自然清香。

words.definition: 原木天然風乾與窯乾乾燥工序

examples.en: Proper wood seasoning in temperature-controlled kilns reduces moisture content to prevent internal stress.
examples.zh: 在溫控木材乾燥窯中進行嚴謹的木材乾燥，將含水率降至8%，徹底釋放內部應力。

examples.en: Add a pinch of sea salt and freshly cracked black pepper as final seasoning before serving the steak.
examples.zh: 在牛排端上桌擺盤之前，撒上一小撮天然海鹽與現磨黑胡椒作為最後的調味提味。

examples.en: Natural air seasoning of thick timber planks can take up to two years in well-ventilated dry sheds.
examples.zh: 在將厚重的原木大板放置在通風良好的乾燥棚內進行自然陰乾風乾，往往需要長達兩年時間。

words.definition: 防止實木板材受潮翹曲變形

examples.en: Thoroughly dried hardwood planks will not warp, bow, or twist during humid summer typhoons.
examples.zh: 經過徹底均勻乾燥的優質硬木大板，在潮濕炎熱的台灣夏季颱風天裡絕不輕易翹曲變形。

examples.en: Intense solar heat through large glass windows can warp cheap plastic window blinds over time.
examples.zh: 透過大片落地窗直射入室內的強烈豔陽高溫，久而久之容易使劣質塑膠百葉窗彎曲變形。

examples.en: Science fiction stories often describe interstellar spaceships capable of traveling at warp speed across galaxies.
examples.zh: 科幻太空小說經常描繪能夠以超越光速的曲速曲折穿越銀河星際的未來太空戰艦。

words.definition: 日本高碳鋼木工雕刻鑿刀；鑿刻

examples.en: Japanese high-carbon steel chisels shave off microscopic wood curls with surgical precision.
examples.zh: 日本高碳鋼鍛造的專業木工鑿刀，能以如外科手術般的細膩精度切削出極微小木屑。

examples.en: The sculptor used a heavy steel chisel and mallet to shape marble features on the statue.
examples.zh: 雕塑大師手持沉重的鋼鑿與木槌，在堅硬的大理石石材上細膩雕琢人物的五官輪廓。

examples.en: You should always sharpen your chisel on a wet stone before undertaking delicate detail cuts.
examples.zh: 在進行精緻細微的木作切削作業前，務必先在油石水石上將你的鑿刀刃口研磨得鋒利無比。

words.definition: 手工木工推刨刨刀；刨平

examples.en: The craftsman adjusts his wooden hand plane to shave paper-thin translucent ribbons of cedar.
examples.zh: 木匠屏氣凝神細心微調手作木工刨刀，輕輕一推便刨出薄如蟬翼、半透明的優美木花。

examples.en: We booked our flight on an eco-friendly modern passenger plane powered by efficient turbofan engines.
examples.zh: 我們預訂了一架由高效渦輪風扇發動機驅動的現代環保型噴射客機機票飛往海外。

examples.en: The mathematician drew two intersecting geometric lines across an infinite two-dimensional plane.
examples.zh: 數學家在黑板上的二維無垠平面上，用粉筆畫出了兩條相互垂直相交的幾何直線。

words.definition: 日式細工拉鋸 (Dozuki 鋸)；鋸開

examples.en: Japanese pull saws cut cleanly on the pull stroke, producing razor-thin kerfs with minimal tear-out.
examples.zh: 日式細工拉鋸在向內拉動時俐落施力鋸切，切口平整光滑且不留毛邊木屑。

examples.en: He used a sharp hand saw to prune dead branches off the fruit trees in the backyard orchard.
examples.zh: 他手持一把鋒利的手工園藝鋸，俐落地將後院果園果樹上的枯萎枝椏一一修剪鋸除。

examples.en: Through the binoculars, she clearly saw a pair of migratory black-faced spoonbills wading in the wetland.
examples.zh: 透過高倍率雙筒望遠鏡，她清晰看見了一對珍貴的保育類黑面琵鷺正在濕地淺灘悠閒漫步。

words.definition: 圓弧形木雕圓鑿；鑿出弧槽

examples.en: Woodcarvers use curved gouges to sculpt fluid contours, ripples, and leaves on temple pillars.
examples.zh: 寺廟雕刻大師手持各式弧度的圓鑿，在巨大的原木廟柱上雕鑿出栩栩如生的祥龍與浪花。

examples.en: Unscrupulous merchants tried to price gouge desperate shoppers buying bottled water after the typhoon.
examples.zh: 不肖黑心商家企圖在強颱侵襲後對急需飲用水的災民坐地起價、漫天要價敲竹槓。

examples.en: The sharp gravel created a deep gouge along the bottom of his carbon-fiber kayak.
examples.zh: 溪流中尖銳嶙峋的碎石暗礁，在他碳纖維獨木舟的底部刮出了一道深深的凹槽刮痕。

words.definition: 打磨實木表面專用砂紙

examples.en: Progressing from coarse 120-grit to ultra-fine 600-grit sandpaper creates a mirror-smooth finish.
examples.zh: 從粗孔 120 號一路按部就班打磨到 600 號超細砂紙，能在木頭表面創造如絲緞般觸感。

examples.en: Use a wooden sanding block with sandpaper to ensure even flat pressure across broad tabletops.
examples.zh: 搭配木質砂磨墊塊包覆砂紙使用，能確保在寬闊的桌面表面施加均勻平整的下壓磨力。

examples.en: Rubbing sandpaper against rusty metal railings removes oxidized paint before repainting.
examples.zh: 用粗砂紙用力擦拭生鏽的鐵欄杆，可以在重新粉刷防鏽漆前有效去除剝落的氧化舊漆。

words.definition: 砂磨整平消除刀痕工序

examples.en: Hours of patient hand sanding highlight the natural silkiness of dense tropical rosewood.
examples.zh: 歷經數小時不厭其煩的耐心手工砂磨打磨，徹底彰顯出頂級紫檀木溫潤細膩的原木光澤。

examples.en: Wearing an N95 dust mask during machine sanding protects your lungs from microscopic wood dust.
examples.zh: 在使用電動砂磨機進行木材拋光作業時佩戴 N95 防塵口罩，能保護肺部免受細微木屑粉塵吸入。

examples.en: The auto body shop finished sanding the dented fender before spraying the primer coat.
examples.zh: 汽車烤漆廠在為凹陷修復的葉子板噴塗底漆前，徹底完成了最後道次的精細砂磨打平。

words.definition: 旋轉切削原木木工車床

examples.en: Spinning a block of camphor wood on the wood lathe transforms rough logs into graceful salad bowls.
examples.zh: 將一塊芳香樟木固定在高速旋轉的木工車床上，運用車刀熟練旋削出弧度優雅的木碗。

examples.en: The precision metal lathe rotates cylindrical steel shafts while carbide cutting bits shape grooves.
examples.zh: 工業精密金屬車床高速旋轉圓柱形鋼軸，碳化鎢車刀則依電腦指令精準切削出密封凹槽。

examples.en: Woodturners wear full-face protective shields when operating high-speed wood lathes.
examples.zh: 車木工藝師在操作高速運轉的木工車床時，習慣佩戴全罩式透明防護面罩以防木料崩飛。

words.definition: 重型實木木工桌 (附木工虎鉗)

examples.en: The heavy solid beechwood workbench absorbs heavy hammer blows without vibrating or shifting.
examples.zh: 重達百公斤的歐洲山毛櫸重型木工工作桌，能吸收強烈敲擊震動而毫不晃動移位。

examples.en: Keep your workbench organized and free of cluttered hand tools to avoid workshop accidents.
examples.zh: 隨時保持木工工作台整潔有序且不堆置雜亂手工具，能有效預防工坊意外受傷。

examples.en: The carpenter attached a front vise to his sturdy workbench for clamping long planks securely.
examples.zh: 木匠在堅固厚重的工作桌前側安裝了一具重型木工虎鉗，用以牢固夾持長條木板進行刨削。

words.definition: 實木拼板專用長型木工夾具；夾緊

examples.en: Parallel bar clamps hold edge-glued oak boards tightly aligned until the PVA glue cures completely.
examples.zh: 數支平行的重型長桿木工夾具，將塗膠拼板的橡木板材緊密夾持固定直至完全乾燥固化。

examples.en: Always place scrap wood between the metal clamp jaws and the workpiece to prevent denting.
examples.zh: 在金屬夾具夾口與精緻工件之間務必墊上一塊廢木片，以防止木料表面產生壓痕。

examples.en: Surgeons used a small vascular clamp to temporarily stop blood flow during the microsurgical operation.
examples.zh: 外科醫生在顯微手術過程中，使用微型止血夾鉗暫時夾閉微血管以有效阻斷血流。

words.definition: 天然名貴原木薄皮；薄板

examples.en: Skilled artisans apply exotic maple veneer with bookmatched symmetry across cabinet doors.
examples.zh: 頂級木藝匠人將珍稀楓木天然木皮以如打開書本般對稱的對花工藝貼合在櫥櫃門片上。

examples.en: Behind his polite veneer of calm professionalism, he was harboring deep resentment toward management.
examples.zh: 在他冷靜專業且謙遜有禮的表面偽裝外表之下，內心深處卻對高層管理階層積怨已久。

examples.en: Natural wood veneer provides the authentic warmth of rare timbers while maximizing eco-friendly yield.
examples.zh: 天然原木薄木皮在展現名貴樹種天然溫潤木質感的同時，亦大幅提高了原木資源的環保利用率。

words.definition: 貝殼與黃銅細木鑲嵌工藝；鑲嵌

examples.en: Delicate mother-of-pearl inlays adorn the headstocks of custom handmade acoustic guitars.
examples.zh: 晶瑩剔透的天然白蝶貝貝殼鑲嵌，華麗點綴在全手工客製化民謠吉他的琴頭之上。

examples.en: The jewelry box featured a traditional brass wire inlay hammered into polished teak wood.
examples.zh: 這只精緻的原木珠寶首飾盒，飾有將細緻黃銅絲手工敲入打磨柚木之中的傳統金工鑲嵌。

examples.en: Decorative mosaic stone inlays were uncovered during excavations of the ancient Roman villa floor.
examples.zh: 考古團隊在發掘這座古羅馬奢華別墅時，在地磚表面出土了色彩斑斕的馬賽克寶石鑲嵌飾品。

words.definition: 環氧樹脂透明河流桌灌注；樹脂

examples.en: Clear blue epoxy resin fills the natural void between two live-edge walnut slabs, mimicking a river.
examples.zh: 蔚藍通透的環氧樹脂澆注在兩片自然邊胡桃木大板之間，打造出宛如山間清澈溪流的河流桌。

examples.en: Pine trees secrete sticky amber resin naturally to heal bark wounds and ward off boring beetles.
examples.zh: 台灣二葉松與松樹受到外傷時會自然分泌黏稠的琥珀色松樹脂，以癒合樹皮傷口並驅趕蛀蟲。

examples.en: Modern 3D resin printers cure liquid photopolymers layer by layer with microscopic ultraviolet beams.
examples.zh: 現代高解析光固化 3D 列印機利用極細微的紫外線光束，將液態光敏樹脂一層層精準固化成型。

words.definition: 保留自然邊的整塊原木大板

examples.en: A massive single-piece monkeypod slab serves as the centerpiece dining table for twelve guests.
examples.zh: 一整塊厚達八公分的一枚板天然邊南洋杉原木大板，成為容納十二人聚會的霸氣長餐桌。

examples.en: Construction workers poured concrete over reinforced steel rebar to form the foundational floor slab.
examples.zh: 營建工人們在密集的鋼筋骨架上方均勻澆置混凝土，以構築起堅固厚實的建築基礎樓板。

examples.en: The stone quarry cut thick granite slabs to be polished into luxury kitchen countertops.
examples.zh: 石材採石場切割出厚重的大理石花崗岩石板，準備送往工廠打磨成高級廚房中島檯面。

words.definition: 天然無毒護木蜂蠟膏

examples.en: Buffing organic beeswax paste into teak cutting boards creates a water-repellent, food-safe protective coating.
examples.zh: 將純天然有機蜂蠟膏均勻推入柚木砧板纖維中，形成一道防水抗污且食器級安全的保護層。

examples.en: Hand-poured pure beeswax candles burn cleanly with a faint honey scent and without toxic soot.
examples.zh: 純手工灌注的天然純蜂蠟蠟燭在燃燒時不散發任何黑煙，反而飄散出淡淡的天然蜂蜜清香。

examples.en: Natural beeswax is a key hydrating ingredient found in organic lip balms and skincare ointments.
examples.zh: 天然蜂蠟是調配頂級有機護唇膏與天然護膚保濕油膏中不可或缺的滋潤保濕核心成分。

words.definition: 熟桐油與天然植物護木油；油

examples.en: Penetrating tung oil cures inside wood pores, creating a durable satin finish without plastic film buildup.
examples.zh: 具備高滲透力的天然熟桐油深入木質毛孔固化，呈現出無塑料反光的絲絨霧面高級質感。

examples.en: Olive oil and sesame oil are staple healthy cooking ingredients across Mediterranean and Asian cuisines.
examples.zh: 特級初榨橄欖油與純黑麻油，分別是地中海料理與台灣傳統養生烹調中最重要的健康食用油脂。

examples.en: The maintenance technician checked the car's engine oil level using the dipstick before the road trip.
examples.zh: 在出發展開長途公路自駕旅行前，保養廠技師抽出機油尺仔細確認了汽車的引擎機油油量。

words.definition: 傳統天然生漆漆藝；生漆

examples.en: Multi-layered natural tree lacquer requires twenty coats, curing slowly in a high-humidity drying cabinet.
examples.zh: 傳統東方天然生漆漆藝需反覆塗刷二十道工序，並在恆溫恆濕的蔭房中緩慢結晶固化。

examples.en: She applied a glossy coat of protective lacquer over the painted birdhouse to weatherproof it.
examples.zh: 她在手繪小鳥木屋的外層塗刷了一層晶瑩剔透的防水清漆，以增強戶外遮風避雨的耐候性。

examples.en: Traditional Japanese lacquerware bowls feature deep black and vermilion red finishes resistant to boiling soups.
examples.zh: 傳統日本天然漆器漆碗呈現出沉穩黝黑與朱紅光澤，具備極佳的耐熱耐酸性且不怕滾燙熱湯。

words.definition: 百年古董老家具細心翻新修復

examples.en: Furniture restoration preserves the original patina of century-old mahogany dressers while reinforcing loose joints.
examples.zh: 專業古董老家具修復技術，在保留百年風化包漿韻味的同時重新加固鬆脫的榫卯。

examples.en: The wetland restoration project successfully brought back dozens of migratory bird species to the lagoon.
examples.zh: 沿海濕地生態棲地復育計畫取得了巨大成功，重新吸引了數十種珍稀候鳥重返潟湖覓食棲息。

examples.en: Following the devastating typhoon, technicians worked tirelessly to achieve full electrical power restoration.
examples.zh: 在強烈颱風重創電網之後，台電工程人員頂著風雨徹夜搶修，全力爭取全區全面供電復原。

words.definition: 永續林業經營與木育推廣

examples.en: Sustainable forestry ensures that for every mature tree harvested for carpentry, five saplings are planted.
examples.zh: 健全的永續林業嚴格落實疏伐計畫，每砍伐一棵成熟製材用樹便在林地補種五株健壯樹苗。

examples.en: He studied urban forestry at university to help cities design resilient green tree canopies.
examples.zh: 他在大學時期專攻都市林業與森林學，旨在協助都會區規劃高抗風韌性的綠蔭樹冠網絡。

examples.en: Responsible community forestry generates local employment while preserving primary rainforest ecosystems.
examples.zh: 落實負責任的社區參與式林業經營，在守護原始森林生態多樣性的同時為在地創造就業生計。

words.definition: 森林資源珍惜撫育管理責任

examples.en: Practicing responsible forest stewardship safeguards clean mountain watersheds and rich biodiversity.
examples.zh: 恪守負責任的森林撫育管理責任，能全面涵養高山清澈水源並守護豐富的森林生態。

examples.en: As caretakers of the historic estate, they demonstrated faithful cultural stewardship of the grounds.
examples.zh: 身為這座歷史古蹟莊園的託管人，他們對莊園的一草一木展現了崇高且忠實的文化守護責任。

examples.en: Good corporate stewardship includes reducing carbon emissions and ensuring fair wages for all supply chain staff.
examples.zh: 卓越的企業環境治理守護精神，包括主動承諾大幅減碳以及確保全球供應鏈勞工皆享有公平工資。

words.definition: 台灣原生國寶珍貴樹種的

examples.en: Planting native hardwood species such as Taiwan incense cedar restores degraded hillside ecosystems.
examples.zh: 大量栽植台灣肖楠、烏心石等台灣原生樹種，能逐步修復受損山林水土保持。

examples.en: English is not her native language, yet she speaks it with remarkable fluency and confidence.
examples.zh: 雖然英語並不是她的母語母體語言，但她在國際商務會議中侃侃而談，口條流利且充滿自信。

examples.en: The indigenous guide possessed an encyclopedic knowledge of native alpine plants and medicinal herbs.
examples.zh: 這位原住民族高山嚮導對台灣高山原生植物與傳統草藥的療效分佈，擁有如百科全書般的精闢掌握。

words.definition: 實木家具固碳效益；碳

examples.en: Solid wood furniture acts as a permanent carbon vault, locking away atmospheric carbon for generations.
examples.zh: 原木實木家具宛如一座座堅固的固碳保險庫，將空氣中的碳元素永久鎖定在木質纖維中。

examples.en: Carbon fiber reinforced polymer delivers exceptional strength while drastically reducing bicycle frame weight.
examples.zh: 碳纖維複合增強材料在大幅減輕公路競速自行車車架重量的同時，提供了無與倫比的高剛性。

examples.en: Major corporations are investing in direct air capture facilities to remove industrial carbon from the atmosphere.
examples.zh: 國際跨國巨頭正大舉投資直接空氣捕捉新創設施，以期從大氣層中直接抽離工業二氧化碳。

words.definition: 頂級手工原木民謠吉他聲學的

examples.en: Master luthiers select resonant tone-woods to produce rich acoustic sustain and vibrant midrange warmth.
examples.zh: 頂級製琴大師嚴選風乾數十年的頂級共鳴音木，打造出音色甜美醇厚、泛音豐富的手工原木民謠吉他。

examples.en: Soundproofing foam panels were installed along the walls to optimize the acoustic quality of the recording booth.
examples.zh: 錄音室牆面四周全面鋪設了高密度吸音海綿板，以最佳化人聲配音錄音間的聲學吸音品質。

examples.en: Marine scientists use specialized acoustic listening devices to detect whale songs hundreds of miles away.
examples.zh: 海洋科學家在深海投放特製的聲學水下監聽收音儀，能清晰探測到數百浬外鯨魚群悠揚的鯨歌。

words.definition: 頂級吉他提琴共鳴面板雲杉木

examples.en: Quarter-sawn Sitka spruce tops provide unmatched stiffness-to-weight ratio for concert violin soundboards.
examples.zh: 徑向剖切的頂級西卡雲杉木面板，為演奏級小提琴與古典吉他帶來無與倫比的穿透爆發力。

examples.en: Forest hikers walked through fragrant spruce forests draped in morning alpine mist.
examples.zh: 登山健行愛好者漫步穿行在被清晨高山薄霧溫柔籠罩的茂密雲杉針葉林中，空氣芬芳宜人。

examples.en: The homeowner decided to spruce up the front porch with fresh paint and hanging potted flowers before the party.
examples.zh: 屋主決定在週末派對舉辦前，用鮮豔的新油漆與吊掛綠意盆栽將前院門廊好好打扮修整一番。

words.definition: 桃花心木（音色溫暖醇厚耐用）

examples.en: Vintage guitar necks carved from solid mahogany deliver round, punchy bass and crystalline high notes.
examples.zh: 以一整根質地堅韌的桃花心木雕琢而成的吉他琴頸，音色溫潤飽滿且結構穩定耐拉力。

examples.en: The boardroom features a grand mahogany conference table polished to a brilliant mirror shine.
examples.zh: 企業董事會總部會議室中央擺放著一張巨大的頂級桃花心木會議桌，表面打磨得如明鏡般耀眼。

examples.en: Harvesting wild mahogany is strictly regulated under international trade agreements to prevent illegal logging.
examples.zh: 野生桃花心木的採伐受到國際瀕危野生動植物貿易公約的嚴格規範管制，以杜絕非法濫伐。

words.definition: 黑檀木 (烏木指板堅硬滑順)

examples.en: Jet-black African ebony fretboards resist fingernail wear, providing a slick, lightning-fast playing surface.
examples.zh: 如黑曜石般漆黑深邃的烏木黑檀木指板極度耐磨堅硬，為演奏家提供如絲般滑順的按弦手感。

examples.en: The artisan hand-turned an exquisite pen holder from a dense block of natural ebony.
examples.zh: 工藝大師使用車床從一塊質地緊密沉實的天然黑檀木中，精心手作旋削出一只典雅的鋼筆架。

examples.en: Traditional piano keyboards traditionally featured keys crafted from white ivory and dark ebony wood.
examples.zh: 百年傳統古典演奏級平台鋼琴的琴鍵，在傳統工藝上歷來是由白色象牙與黑色烏木精工打造。

words.definition: 實木溫潤質樸的指尖觸感體驗

examples.en: Running your fingertips over oil-finished walnut offers a deeply soothing, warm tactile experience.
examples.zh: 用指尖輕輕撫摸過推油處理的天然胡桃木桌板，能感受到大自然無可取代、溫暖細緻的觸覺體驗。

examples.en: Children learn fundamental shape recognition and spatial geometry rapidly through interactive tactile toys.
examples.zh: 幼兒透過親手觸摸不同材質的立體感官互動玩具，能快速建立對基礎幾何形狀與空間的概念認知。

examples.en: The luxury smartphone features haptic vibration motors that provide realistic tactile feedback when typing.
examples.zh: 旗艦級智慧型手機內建精密觸覺線性震動馬達，在虛擬鍵盤打字時能帶來如同實體按鍵的逼真觸感回饋。

words.definition: 匠心獨具的精湛手工工匠精神

examples.en: Generational wood craftsmanship transforms humble logs into timeless functional works of art.
examples.zh: 代代相傳的卓越手工工藝精神，將樸實無華的山林原木昇華為歷久彌新的傳世藝術品。

examples.en: The handmade leather briefcase showcases meticulous stitching and world-class Italian craftsmanship.
examples.zh: 這只全手工縫製的頂級牛皮公事包，展現出一絲不苟的細膩針腳與世界一流的義大利匠人技術。

examples.en: Appreciating traditional craftsmanship fosters a deeper understanding of cultural values and history.
examples.zh: 由衷鑑賞傳承悠久的傳統工匠精神，能讓我們對深厚的民俗文化底蘊與歷史發展產生更深刻的體悟。

words.definition: 畢生專注木藝創作的工匠職人

examples.en: The dedicated artisan spends forty hours hand-carving a single sculptural rocking chair.
examples.zh: 這位心無旁騖的木藝工匠職人，耗費整整四十小時手工雕鑿打磨出一張線條如流水般的搖椅。

examples.en: Visiting the weekend artisan market in Taichung allowed us to buy handmade ceramics and organic soaps.
examples.zh: 週末造訪台中綠園道旁的手作職人文創市集，讓我們買到了許多獨一無二的手捏陶器與天然手工皂。

examples.en: The crusty sourdough bread was baked early this morning by a local French artisan baker.
examples.zh: 這款外脆內韌的天然酸種法式歐包，是由當地的法籍職人烘焙師於今天破曉清晨新鮮手工出爐的。

words.definition: 慢工出細活的無比耐心定力

examples.en: Fine woodworking teaches deep patience, demanding that every measurement and cut be made without haste.
examples.zh: 精密細木作工藝陶冶心性，教會人們沉澱浮躁、慢工出細活的無比耐心，在每一次落刀間保持從容與專注。

examples.en: It takes immense patience and empathy to teach basic digital smartphone skills to elderly grandparents.
examples.zh: 耐心引導並手把手教導高齡銀髮阿公阿嬤學會操作智慧型手機各項功能，需要無比的耐心與同理心。

examples.en: Waiting in the passport renewal line tested the patience of travelers during the pre-holiday rush.
examples.zh: 在連假出國旅遊高峰期排在長長的換發護照隊伍中苦苦等候，極度考驗著每位旅客的耐心耐性。

words.definition: 接納原木天然樹結紋理之美；瑕疵

examples.en: Natural knots and mineral streaks are not flaws, but celebrated character marks honoring the tree’s life story.
examples.zh: 原木上的天然樹結與礦物紋理絕非瑕疵缺陷，而是大自然為這棵大樹一生的風霜所烙下的獨特印記。

examples.en: Hand-thrown clay teacups celebrate tiny cosmetic imperfections that reveal the human touch of the potter.
examples.zh: 手拉胚陶藝茶杯不刻意抹除燒製中的微小瑕疵與自然縮釉，反而更能體現陶藝師手作的質樸溫度。

examples.en: Learning to accept one's personal physical imperfections is a vital step toward developing genuine self-love.
examples.zh: 學會坦然接納自己外在或性格上的不完美與小缺憾，是培養由衷自我肯定與自愛的重要基石。

words.definition: 侘寂崇尚自然質樸的不對稱美學

examples.en: The rustic wabi-sabi aesthetic embraces raw textures, organic curves, and unadorned timber beauty.
examples.zh: 崇尚回歸本真的侘寂美學，由衷讚美未經雕飾的粗獷肌理、自然曲線與大地的質樸之美。

examples.en: The modern cafe adopted a sleek Scandinavian aesthetic featuring minimalist pine furniture and white walls.
examples.zh: 這家文青咖啡館採用了俐落優雅的北歐斯堪地那維亞設計美學，陳設簡約松木家具與明亮白牆。

examples.en: Beyond pure mechanical utility, product designers must satisfy the customer’s emotional and aesthetic desires.
examples.zh: 除了追求卓越純粹的機械實用功能外，當代工業設計師還必須深刻滿足消費者的情感與視覺美學渴望。

words.definition: 世代傳承百年的傳家寶實木家具

examples.en: A well-built solid wood dining table becomes a treasured family heirloom passed down across four generations.
examples.zh: 一張結構嚴謹、用料扎實的實木大餐桌，能跨越四代人的一生時光，成為承載全家溫馨記憶的傳家寶。

examples.en: She wore her great-grandmother's diamond engagement ring as a precious bridal heirloom on her wedding day.
examples.zh: 在婚禮當天，新娘鄭重戴上了曾祖母代代相傳的百年鑽戒，作為最珍貴神聖的家族傳家之寶。

examples.en: Farmers in the eastern rift valley cultivate heirloom rice varieties preserved for over a century.
examples.zh: 花東縱谷的有機農民悉心保種並栽植繁育已傳承百年的珍貴地方原生老品種傳家水稻。

words.definition: 為現代水泥家居注入大地溫潤暖意

examples.en: Adding natural wood elements infuses minimalist concrete living rooms with cozy organic warmth.
examples.zh: 在現代簡約冷冽的清水模客廳中添置幾件原木家具，瞬間為居家空間注入一股來自大地的溫潤暖意。

examples.en: The heartfelt smile and friendly greetings of the B&B owner brought genuine warmth to the tired hikers.
examples.zh: 民宿老闆娘真誠燦爛的笑容與貼心的問候關懷，為疲憊不堪的登山客心中帶來了無比的溫暖。

examples.en: We gathered around the stone fireplace to enjoy the comforting thermal warmth on a freezing winter night.
examples.zh: 在寒流來襲氣溫驟降的冬夜裡，大家圍坐在石造壁爐旁取暖，享受著柴火散發出舒心愜意的融融暖意。

words.definition: 人心與大自然原木的心靈共鳴；共鳴

examples.en: Touching living wood evokes a primal emotional resonance connecting humans back to primordial forests.
examples.zh: 輕撫有生命的實木紋理，在每個人心靈深處喚起一股與遠古原始森林血脈相連的深刻心靈共鳴。

examples.en: The author's poignant memoir about growing up in rural Taiwan struck an immediate emotional resonance with readers.
examples.zh: 這位知名作家描述在台灣鄉村農村成長點滴的真情回憶錄，立刻在各個世代讀者心中激起了強烈共鳴。

examples.en: Tuning forks vibrate in acoustic resonance when struck at identical natural frequencies.
examples.zh: 當兩個音叉被調諧至完全相同的自然頻率時，敲擊其中一個即會引發另一個產生強烈的聲學共振。

words.definition: 歷久彌新不褪流行的經典設計

examples.en: Classic mid-century wooden armchairs possess a timeless elegance that outlasts transient fast-furniture trends.
examples.zh: 經典北歐中世紀實木扶手椅具備歷久彌新的優雅氣質，完全禁得起快時尚家具潮起潮落的考驗。

examples.en: Shakespeare’s plays explore timeless human themes of love, ambition, jealousy, and redemption.
examples.zh: 莎士比亞的經典戲劇深刻探討了跨越世紀、歷久彌新的永恆人類主題：愛恨、野心、嫉妒與救贖。

examples.en: A crisp white linen shirt paired with dark jeans is a timeless fashion combination that never looks dated.
examples.zh: 剪裁合身的白亞麻襯衫搭配深色牛仔褲，是一種經典不褪流行且永遠大方得體的雋永穿搭。

words.definition: 對千年山林神木的虔誠敬畏之心

examples.en: Indigenous carvers offer prayers before harvesting fallen trees, demonstrating profound reverence for the forest spirits.
examples.zh: 原住民傳統雕刻師在取用倒伏巨木前必先虔誠祈福，展現對山林萬物生靈由衷的虔誠敬畏。

examples.en: Temple visitors bowed their heads in quiet reverence as monks chanted sacred Buddhist mantras.
examples.zh: 當寺廟中的僧侶齊聲唱誦神聖的梵音佛經時，前來參拜的信眾無不肅然起敬、低頭合十虔誠敬拜。

examples.en: His deep lifelong reverence for natural ecosystems inspired him to dedicate his career to environmental law.
examples.zh: 他自幼對浩瀚自然生態系統懷抱著深切的虔誠敬畏，促使他一生全心投入環境法規倡議領域。

words.definition: 依個人需求量身客製的實木作品

examples.en: The studio crafts bespoke kitchen islands tailored precisely to the homeowner’s cooking habits and height.
examples.zh: 工作室為業主量身客製打造專屬實木中島料理台，完美貼合掌廚者的身高曲線與烹飪動線。

examples.en: The gentleman ordered a bespoke three-piece wool suit tailored by a renowned London savile row tailor.
examples.zh: 這位紳士專程向享譽全球的倫敦薩維爾街老牌裁縫師，訂製了一套全手工量身剪裁的三件式羊毛西裝。

examples.en: The software agency develops bespoke mobile applications designed specifically for cold-chain logistics companies.
examples.zh: 這家頂尖軟體研發團隊專門為低溫冷鏈物流大廠量身打造客製化行動智慧排程應用程式。

words.definition: 凝聚一生匠心的傳世木藝傑作

examples.en: After three years of carving, the master carpenter unveiled his breathtaking architectural wooden masterpiece.
examples.zh: 歷經整整三年精雕細琢，木作大師終於向世人揭幕這件令人嘆為觀止、凝聚畢生功力的傳世木藝傑作。

examples.en: Da Vinci's Mona Lisa is widely celebrated as one of the most enigmatic artistic masterpieces in history.
examples.zh: 達文西筆下的《蒙娜麗莎的微笑》，被公認為人類藝術史上最神秘動人且耐人尋味的傳世傑作之一。

examples.en: The orchestra’s flawless rendition of Beethoven’s Ninth Symphony was hailed by critics as a musical masterpiece.
examples.zh: 國家交響樂團對貝多芬第九號交響曲天衣無縫的磅礡演繹，被各大樂評家一致盛讚為罕見的音樂顛峰之作。
